_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV decroissante: Pharma segment revenue (92% du CA), Pharma profit (vrai moteur de marge), GMPD profit (segment en redressement crucial pour these), Other segment profit (croissance specialty/MSO), CVS concentration (risque client #1).

kpis.signal: 92% du CA total, baisse FY25 due a expiration contrats OptumRx, offset par croissance branded/specialty
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions FY25 (juillet 2024 - juin 2025). Baisse 3% due a expiration contrats OptumRx (17% du CA conso FY24), partiellement compensee par croissance branded/specialty.
kpis.description_en: Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions segment revenue FY25 (July 2024 - June 2025). Down 3% due to OptumRx contracts expiration (17% of FY24 consolidated revenue), partially offset by branded/specialty growth.

kpis.signal: Vrai moteur de marge, croissance +12% FY25 malgre baisse de CA, prouve resilience modele
kpis.description_fr: Segment profit Pharma FY25, +12% YoY malgre revenue -3%. Croissance portee par programme generiques, BioPharma Solutions, plateformes MSO (Management Service Organizations), nouvelle acquisition GI Alliance (73% janvier 2025).
kpis.description_en: Pharma segment profit FY25, +12% YoY despite -3% revenue. Growth driven by generics program, BioPharma Solutions, MSO platforms (Management Service Organizations), new GI Alliance acquisition (73% January 2025).

kpis.signal: Segment en spectaculaire redressement (-147M FY23 a +135M FY25), pillier these turnaround Cardinal
kpis.description_fr: Profit segment Global Medical Products and Distribution FY25, +47% YoY. Turnaround spectaculaire vs perte -147M FY23. Croissance volume clients existants, normalisation post-COVID PPE et inflation transport.
kpis.description_en: Global Medical Products and Distribution segment profit FY25, +47% YoY. Spectacular turnaround vs -$147M loss in FY23. Volume growth from existing customers, post-COVID PPE and transportation inflation normalization.

kpis.signal: Croissance forte at-Home Solutions, Nuclear & Precision Health, OptiFreight Logistics, segments specialty profitables
kpis.description_fr: Profit segment Other FY25, +22%. Inclut at-Home Solutions (Edgepark medical supplies), Nuclear and Precision Health Solutions, OptiFreight Logistics. CA segment $5.4 Mds $ FY25 (+19% YoY).
kpis.description_en: Other segment profit FY25, +22%. Includes at-Home Solutions (Edgepark medical supplies), Nuclear and Precision Health Solutions, OptiFreight Logistics. Segment revenue $5.4B FY25 (+19% YoY).

kpis.signal: Risque client #1 critique apres expiration OptumRx, CVS represente 27% CA FY25 et 26% creances commerciales brutes
kpis.description_fr: Part de CVS Health Corporation dans le CA consolide FY25, 27%. Egalement 26% du solde brut des creances commerciales au 30 juin 2025. Risque client #1 post-departure OptumRx.
kpis.description_en: CVS Health Corporation share of FY25 consolidated revenue, 27%. Also 26% of gross trade receivables balance at June 30, 2025. Top customer risk post-OptumRx departure.

kpis_story: Cardinal Health FY25 montre profit Pharma robuste +12% malgre choc OptumRx (-17% CA conso perdu), turnaround GMPD spectaculaire (de -147M en FY23 a +135M en FY25), et croissance specialty Other +22%. Risque structurel: concentration CVS 27% du CA.
_notes: FY = annee fiscale CAH (juillet-juin). FY25 = juil 2024 - juin 2025. Historique 3 ans seulement (FY23/24/25) car decoupage segments change debut FY24 (old: Pharmaceutical + Medical; new: Pharma + GMPD + Other). ANTI-INVENTION: tous chiffres extraits directement des tables segment du 10-K FY25 et historique du 10-K FY24.
